thread:
sophia_cs: Heads-up: Novum Data had repeated timeouts from EU customers during a leadership demo at 09:40 UTC. They asked if we can route demo traffic to an EU edge and temporarily raise QPS. Renewal check in 18 days, flagged as at-risk if perf looks bad.

liam_se: Do we know which routes? approx qps?

sophia_cs: Mostly /v1/generate and /v1/chat stream. They reported ~150rps sustained for 6m with spikes to ~320rps. Errors look like proxy 504s from eu cluster. Customer requested eu-edge + 2x qps for the demo window (same-day).

anya_netops: We can enable eu-central-1-edge and add their CIDRs to the allowlist. Need exact IP ranges and window. Recommend ACL TTL matching the demo + auto-revoke.

sophia_cs: CIDRs provided: 46.101.64.0/22, 198.51.100.96/27. Demo window requested 12:009:00 UTC a 9h window today.

anya_netops: Creating ACL entry "novum-demo-5077" -> acl-10021. Will apply to eu-central-1-edge and set auto-revoke at +9h.

liam_se: For safety set a per-route QPS override on their token route rather than adjusting global quotas. I suggest x2 for 9h and pin to burst pool. I can push the override.

eric_infra: I can spin up a small burst node group in eu-central-1 (2x T4 equiv) and tag: novum-burst-5077. Will disable autoscale during the window. Opening INC-4512 and tagging eng-sre.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-4512 "Novum demo: eu-edge allowlist + temp qps override" by eric_infra. ETA: 60m.

sophia_cs: Please add renewal note: customer said demo outcome will influence contract renewal. Set renewal_risk: high.

anya_netops: ACL applied, rule id acl-10021. Please confirm customer can test.

sophia_cs: I sent test curl and scheduled smoke at 12:05 UTC. curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $NOVUM_DEMO" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-fast","input":"latency test"}'
```

liam_se: I'll watch traces and token-latency. If errors persist we'll fallback to hosted-eu-replica and throttle bursts.

eric_infra: Burst nodes up, route override pushed (x2), auto-revoke scheduled at +9h. Closing loop after post-demo report. :thumbsup:

sophia_cs: Thanks team. I'll capture demo feedback and update renewal tracker + playbook. :memo:
